ProjectControlling.Query: SELECT c.ID, [fk_tblAktivitaet], [Nummer], v.Titel as Vorgang, f.Name1 as Firma, a.Nachname + ', ' + a.Vorname as Bearbeiter, [Benennung], FORMAT([Plandatum], 'dd.MM. ') + [Benennung] AS Titel, c.[Beschreibung], c.[Bemerkung], c.[Ergebnis], [Startdatum], [Endedatum], [Dauer] / 60 as Planstunden, [Kostenpflichtig], [Plandatum], FORMAT([Plandatum], 'dd.MM.') AS Beginn FROM [topteam].[dbo].[tblAktivitaetChecklistenPunkte] c join [topteam].[dbo].[tblAktivitaet] v on v.id = c.fk_tblAktivitaet join [topteam].[dbo].[tblFirma] f on v.fk_tblFirma = f.ID join [topteam].[dbo].[tblAnsprechpartner] a on c.fk_Bearbeiter = a.ID where fk_tblAktivitaet = 61583 and c.fk_tblStatus <> 5 order by Plandatum
